relationships.subject: LPS
relationships.evidence_quote: LPS treatment significantly increased spinal levels of 12-HETE and 15-HETE (but not of PGE2) compared with aCSF controls

relationships.subject: 12(S)-HETE
relationships.evidence_quote: IT delivery of 12(S)-HETE or 15(S)-HETE at 100 ng or 1 μg produced a dose-dependent, robust tactile allodynia

relationships.subject: ML351
relationships.evidence_quote: post-treatment with ML355 or ML351 (30 mg/kg IP) reversed IT LPS-induced tactile allodynia at 6 and 24h

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that spinal TLR4 activation increases 12/15-LOX metabolites to mediate pain-like behaviors

key_findings: 12/15-LOX metabolites mediate TLR4-dependent, NSAID-insensitive nociplastic pain in female C57BL/6N mice
12/15-LOX inhibitors reverse allodynia and grip force deficits
